seeds.note: layout has no randomness: histogram modes seed least-squares fits

warnings.message: GeoCalib and MoGe-2 disagree on the vertical field of view

diagnostics.memoryNote: torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated per stage; excludes the CUDA context

canonical.encoding: sRGB JPEG q92, EXIF-oriented, all metadata removed

upCam.note: unit up vector, camera-opencv frame; sigma in degrees

pitchUp.note: asin(upCam.z): positive when the camera looks up, degrees

verticalFov.note: used for geometry; source moge: GeoCalib's own vFOV sigma 6.54 deg > 5.0 deg: focal weakly determined, so MoGe-2's estimate from the dense geometry is used

depth.encoding: uint16 millimetres along the optical axis; 0 = invalid

normals.encoding: RGB = (n + 1) / 2 * 255, camera-opencv frame, facing the camera; 0,0,0 = invalid

depthPreview.encoding: colour-mapped depth, near = red, far = blue; for people, not data

planeLabels.encoding: uint8 plane label per pixel (plane.label), 0 = no plane

planesPreview.encoding: photo tinted by fitted plane role; for people, not data

scale.note: the error of the global scale has not been measured; it needs the tape-measured evaluation set

instanceMasks.encoding: COCO uncompressed RLE per instance, column-major; index = instance order

instancesPreview.encoding: photo tinted by instance mask, labelled; for people, not data

manhattan.note: share of vertical surface area within +-10 deg of the four axes (measured, not a score)

cameraHeight.note: metres above the fitted floor, before calibration

floorOutline.note: convex hull of visible floor pixels

greyWorld.cctMethod: McCamy's approximation from CIE xy; meaningful only near the black-body locus
greyWorld.note: mean of the interior's well-exposed pixels; biased by the room's own colours

ceiling.cctMethod: McCamy's approximation from CIE xy; meaningful only near the black-body locus
ceiling.note: median of the ceiling's well-exposed pixels: bounce light, times the ceiling's own colour

shading.method: Huber-weighted least squares of linear luminance on capture-frame normals, per region

gradient.method: least squares of log linear luminance on capture-frame position over walls and ceiling; one intercept per plane
gradient.note: a gradient of 0.1 per metre is about 10% brighter per metre towards the source
